简介: Jordi Webber is a 27 year old Actor/Musician out of New Zealand. He is of Maori heritage with a mix of English/Irish. His credits include Nomad (US Indie), The Deadlands (AMC), Power Rangers (Nickelodeon) ,Mistletoe Ranch (AU) Head High (SPP), Shortland Street (SPP), Nevernight (AU) and more He performs under kiwi music act 'Waazzoo and the vibes', an alternative pop/roots based in Auckland New Zealand
